_doc: c03: level trims in dB for single notes whose samples swell 5-10 dB over their track's CC11 fit (critic B c03 #4). {track: {onset qn: dB}}, matched within 0.02 qn of the score onset, no length condition; applied in vol_db from 0 dB at the onset to the full trim at onset + 0.6 s, held to the note end. c04: Vc 238 -10 (keeps its level after the eased cut), Vc 3 -5, Fl1/Ob2/Bn1 at 262 (B #1), Vla 220 +4 (C #5). c05: Bn1 196 -9, 262 -5, 269 -7; Vc 190 -4, 253 -5, 261 -8, 81 -6 (B #1-#3); Timp 271 -4 (B #5). c06: Cl1 266 removed (A #2: it deepened the A flat 5 sag; pitch_trims.json now covers it); Timp 277/278.5/279 +3 (B #6); Tbn1 fall inside the ff, bars 63-64 (C #6). c07: Fl1 262 -6 -> -3, Fl2 262 -6 (B #3); Bn2 172/182 -7 -> -2 and 252/253 -6 -> -1, since the Db3 pitch trim (-5) now covers them (B #5); Horn 4 286 -5, 289 -3 (B #6). c08: Vc 238 -10 -> -6 (B #2); Cl1 266 -5 (B #3, cancels the Ab5 pitch trim at ff); Fl1 262 -3 removed, 254 -8 -> -4 (B #1, the Bb6 pitch trim covers them); crescendo goals (C #2 fallback): Vln I 80 +3 / 82 +2, Vln II 80 +3, Ob1 57 +4 / 148 +5, Fl1 129 / 129.5 +3. c09: Bassoon 2 259 -5 (B #6, its bar 78 f arrival was the loudest woodwind, over the melody flute). c10: Bassoon 1 231 +4 (A #2, a body sag of 6-9 dB); Timpani 277/278.5/279 +3 removed, replaced by the role Timpani [277, 280, 10] (B #4: a note trim ramps in over 0.6 s, so it lifted the ring, not the strokes). c12: theme A per-pitch corrections (B #1): Vln I 68 +4, 72 -3, 80 3 -> 6, 82 2 -> 3.5; Vln II 68 +6, 70 +3, 80 3 -> 8, 82 +2. Bar 79 winds (C #1, B #3): Fl2 262 -6 -> -3, Ob2 262 -4 -> -1, Bn1 262 -5 -> -2. c15 (A #1): Clarinet 1 204 +2 with the Ab4 pitch trim skipped there (pitch_trims _skip_onsets): at ff the +6 Ab4 trim put 204 about 5 dB over the 206 Db5. c16: Fl1 271 +3 (B #1); Ob1 144 +7, 145.5 +3 (B #2); Hn1 264 +2 (B #3). c20: Flute 1 258 -3 (critic B #4, the eighth jumped 5 dB with no fill). c22: compensations for the CC11 pull bug (A #1) removed: Bassoon 1 196 -9 -> 0, Horn 4 286 -5 -> -1; Horn 1 32 2.5 -> -2 with its F4 pitch trim skipped (C #1c: the crescendo ramp carries the F4 up into the Bb4 crest). c24: C #1 Vln I/II 83 +2.5, 84 +1 (the 6 dB fall after the bar 28 crest steps down the printed >). B #3 Harp harmonics 276 +5 (the E flat 6 sat 7 dB under the C6 before it). c25: Cl1 292 +3 (3.0 s ramp; holds the coda resolution against the sample decay, A #1); Ob1 190 -8 -> -4, Cl1 256 -5 -> -2, Vc 180 -7 -> -2 (A #3: the old trims made holes inside printed crescendos; Ob1 190/Cl1 256 now steps, Vc 180 1.8 s ramp; Ob1 45 keeps -7 on a 2.1 s ramp); Vc 204 -3, 265 -4 (B #1: the f/ff A flat 3 sample is 4-6 dB hot); Horns 1-2 a2 261 -3 (0.1 s ramp, B #3: the p< pickup peaked over its f arrival); Bass clarinet 108 -3 (B #4: under the flute's theme B entry). v600 port (series 2, c27, 2026-11-06): every onset key checked against v600 (pitch, length, the note before, printed dynamic, articulation); removed or moved: Flute 1 254, Flute 1 129, Flute 1 129.5, Flute 1 258, Clarinet 1 256, Clarinet 1 204, Bass clarinet 93, Bass clarinet 108, Bassoon 1 208, Bassoon 1 269, Bassoon 2 172, Bassoon 2 182, Bassoon 2 190, Bassoon 2 196, Bassoon 2 253, Violoncellos 139, Violoncellos 164, Violoncellos 180, Violoncellos 261, Violoncellos 81, Violoncellos 265, Timpani 271, Violins I 82, Violins I 83, Violins I 84, Violins II 82, Violins II 83, Violins II 84, Horn 1 180, Harp harmonics 276, Horns 1-2 a2 261. c29 (critic B #5): Violoncellos 265 -4 (A flat 3 at f/ff stood 6-7 dB over its neighbours, as the bar 61 A flat 3 with its -3), Cor anglais 266 -3.

_c53: c53 (critic B #3): Horn 1 counter-melody bars 57-59 went up and down by 5-8 dB from note to note under one crescendo (the F4 pitch trim was set on soft notes): 192 +3.5, 190 -2.0, 198 +1.5 -> +3.0 (ramps 0.2 s on 192 and 198, NOTE_TRIM_RAMP_S). B's +4 on the pickup at 195.5 is a LEVEL_SHAPES_S row in build/score_config.py (a note trim holds to the note end and then falls inside the breath, which lifted the gap floor 2.5 dB).
